Summary: Jesus' charge to the Twelve on their first mission: preach that the kingdom is at hand, heal the sick, cleanse lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils, freely give — wise as serpents, harmless as doves, shaking dust from unwelcoming towns.
Commandment: Go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand. Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
Application: Grouped as one mission charge because it was given as one sending. Whether its details (no bag, no staff, shaking dust) bind later missions or belonged to that sending is debated; its preaching, healing, and freely-giving heart is the enduring pattern churches draw from it.
Purpose: Scripture's own reason: 'freely ye have received, freely give' (Matthew 10:8).
